summary.en: Strong coding and reasoning, cost-effective, good Chinese support.
summary.zh: 代码和推理能力强，性价比高，中文支持好。

title.en: DeepSeek API Key - Official Access for DeepSeek Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: DeepSeek API Key - 深度求索模型官方入口 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get official DeepSeek API key for DeepSeek-V3, Coder, and R1 models. Strong coding and reasoning capabilities.
description.zh: 获取 DeepSeek-V3、Coder 和 R1 模型的官方 API Key。强大的代码和推理能力。

en: DeepSeek provides coding- and reasoning-strong models such as DeepSeek-V3.2, Coder, R1, and Reasoner via its own platform APIs.
Developers often pick DeepSeek for cost-effective Chinese-friendly coding agents and long reasoning traces without hosting the weights themselves.
zh: DeepSeek（深度求索）通过自有平台提供偏代码与推理的模型，如 DeepSeek-V3.2、Coder、R1、Reasoner。
开发者常因高性价比、中文友好与较强编程/推理能力而选择 DeepSeek，无需自托管权重。

en: Register or sign in at platform.deepseek.com.
Open API Keys at https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys and create a new key.
Copy the key when it is displayed and keep it out of public repos.
Call DeepSeek’s OpenAI-compatible chat APIs with that key using platform.deepseek.com API docs.
zh: 在 platform.deepseek.com 注册或登录。
打开 https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys 并创建新密钥。
在展示时复制保存，勿提交到公开代码仓库。
按平台 API 文档，用该 Key 调用 DeepSeek 兼容 OpenAI 的对话接口。

question.zh: DeepSeek API 是否兼容 OpenAI？

answer.en: Yes. The platform documents OpenAI-compatible endpoints; use your DeepSeek key and the official base URL.
answer.zh: 是。平台文档提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口；使用 DeepSeek Key 与官方 base URL 即可。

question.en: Which DeepSeek models need a platform key?
question.zh: 哪些 DeepSeek 模型需要平台 Key？

answer.en: Official cloud access to V3.2, Coder, R1, and Reasoner lines is via platform API keys. Check the console for current model IDs.
answer.zh: V3.2、Coder、R1、Reasoner 等云端调用通过平台 API Key。当前模型 ID 以控制台为准。
